register.title: PingYou Ltd's n302 certificate at 5a86ac3, issue564
register.headline: A packing of 302 squares from four boundary patches of Ryan Xu's packing of 70 and two upright banks
register.source_checks: The author reports that three exact checkers, its own rational polygon-projection checker and Evan Daniel's unchanged verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py, accept all 302 squares, 1,208 wall conditions and 45,451 pairs; that its package replays the recorded rational construction and checks the lossless conversion to its corners Witness/v2; and that this repository's sqpack exact_verify and check_rational_witness_independent, unchanged at 074ac28, accept that witness. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit PingYou Ltd (https://github.com/BuddenPing/square-packing-certificates) with the n302 construction and its refinement, as the source asks: four boundary patches of Ryan Xu's n70 construction (ry-xu, issue 432), taken from Evan Daniel's exact n70 certificate (the regularized n-070 certificate T-146 retains), with two upright banks of 105 and 147 squares. The source names Nate Chaoweeraprasit's SQUISH n302 (issue 481) and Evan Daniel's regularization of it (T-146) only as its comparison, and claims neither the n70 packing nor patch composition in general. The pinned source makes no statement about AI assistance; the author's statement of 12 October on issue 503 covers the n207 and n153 results only.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide adoption at 302: the certificate is 1.75e-3 below the ceiling T-146 holds, but Francisco Couzo's #583, which continues this arrangement, prints a side 2.62e-4 smaller, Mishapolk's #593 one 1.79e-10 smaller, and the author's own PR #574 states smaller sides, so adoption waits on their imports. Final exact-head CI remains required.
